subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and what should the canonical config name/default/per-account inheritance be?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented Feishu setting, and adding an opt-out changes channel config and media-context behavior for existing users.

options.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to current media download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel media-ingestion policy if maintainers want one attachment-context setting across channel plugins.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports only mediaMaxMb and no content-ignore switch, leaving downloads as the intentional default.

recommendation.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu top-level/per-account option that defaults to current media download behavior and sends only placeholders when disabled.
